_about: Edits scripts/i18n-ios.mjs cannot make by itself: a sentence built by appending an s becomes two whole sentences (one / other), each a key of its own. Works without a catalog (tests, previews) and needs no plural variations. `wrap` applies them; each is skipped when its `find` text is absent.

edits.replace: (n == 1 ? String(localized: "Kept on \(n) other server") : String(localized: "Kept on \(n) other servers"))
(n == 1 ? String(localized: "Restored \(n) app") : String(localized: "Restored \(n) apps"))
Text(hiddenMessages == 1 ? String(localized: "… \(hiddenMessages) earlier message not shown") : String(localized: "… \(hiddenMessages) earlier messages not shown"))
Text(d.browserTabs.count == 1 ? String(localized: "\(d.browserTabs.count) tab running server-side") : String(localized: "\(d.browserTabs.count) tabs running server-side"))
(hours == 1 ? String(localized: "\(Int(hours)) hour") : String(localized: "\(Int(hours)) hours"))

Text([r.totalRewritten == 1 ? String(localized: "\(r.totalRewritten) row rewritten") : String(localized: "\(r.totalRewritten) rows rewritten"), r.reattachedCount == 1 ? String(localized: "\(r.reattachedCount) app") : String(localized: "\(r.reattachedCount) apps")].joined(separator: " · "))
Text("Membership rows re-anchored: \(r.totalRewritten). Apps affected: \(r.reattachedCount).")
Text(app.rewrittenCount == 1 ? String(localized: "\(app.rewrittenCount) row re-anchored") : String(localized: "\(app.rewrittenCount) rows re-anchored"))
Text(r.fileCount == 1 ? String(localized: "\(r.reason) — \(r.fileCount) file.") : String(localized: "\(r.reason) — \(r.fileCount) files."))

edits.find: Text("The AI rewrote this repo into a Flagship service\(n > 0 ? " (\(n) file\(n == 1 ? "" : "s"))" : "").")
edits.replace: Text(n == 0 ? String(localized: "The AI rewrote this repo into a Flagship service.") : n == 1 ? String(localized: "The AI rewrote this repo into a Flagship service (\(n) file).") : String(localized: "The AI rewrote this repo into a Flagship service (\(n) files)."))
(b.entryCount == 1 ? String(localized: "Started \(Self.timeString(b.startedAt)) · \(b.entryCount) step") : String(localized: "Started \(Self.timeString(b.startedAt)) · \(b.entryCount) steps"))
(h.bricks == 1 ? String(localized: "\(h.bricks) piece") : String(localized: "\(h.bricks) pieces"))
(days == 1 ? String(localized: "Restore by \(formatTime(keepUntil)) (\(days) day left).") : String(localized: "Restore by \(formatTime(keepUntil)) (\(days) days left)."))

edits.find: String(localized: "\(s.holders) server\(s.holders == 1 ? "" : "s") hold its pieces; \(s.needed) bring it back.")
edits.replace: String(localized: "Servers holding its pieces: \(s.holders). Needed to bring it back: \(s.needed).")
(min == 1 ? String(localized: "\(min) minute ago") : String(localized: "\(min) minutes ago"))
(hr == 1 ? String(localized: "\(hr) hour ago") : String(localized: "\(hr) hours ago"))
(day == 1 ? String(localized: "\(day) day ago") : String(localized: "\(day) days ago"))
(min == 1 ? String(localized: "in about \(min) minute") : String(localized: "in about \(min) minutes"))
(h == 1 ? String(localized: "in about \(h) hour") : String(localized: "in about \(h) hours"))

edits.find: String(localized: "This Mac is at its hosting limit (\(cap) server\(cap == 1 ? "" : "s")). Remove one first, or burn to USB.")
edits.replace: (cap == 1 ? String(localized: "This Mac is at its hosting limit (\(cap) server). Remove one first, or burn to USB.") : String(localized: "This Mac is at its hosting limit (\(cap) servers). Remove one first, or burn to USB."))

edits.find: return String(localized: "\(observation.summary). Last guest checkpoint \(relativeAge(observation.updatedAt, now: now)); \(elapsed) minute\(elapsed == 1 ? "" : "s") total.")
edits.replace: return elapsed == 1 ? String(localized: "\(observation.summary). Last guest checkpoint \(relativeAge(observation.updatedAt, now: now)); \(elapsed) minute total.") : String(localized: "\(observation.summary). Last guest checkpoint \(relativeAge(observation.updatedAt, now: now)); \(elapsed) minutes total.")

edits.find: return String(localized: "\(server.record.config.firstBootSummary); \(elapsed) minute\(elapsed == 1 ? "" : "s") so far. Progress appears here once the server checks in.")
edits.replace: return elapsed == 1 ? String(localized: "\(server.record.config.firstBootSummary); \(elapsed) minute so far. Progress appears here once the server checks in.") : String(localized: "\(server.record.config.firstBootSummary); \(elapsed) minutes so far. Progress appears here once the server checks in.")
return minutes == 1 ? String(localized: "\(minutes) minute ago") : String(localized: "\(minutes) minutes ago")
